tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Returns recent seismic events from the Icelandic Meteorological Office (Veðurstofa Íslands, api.vedur.is/quakes), filtered by minimum magnitude, lookback hours (1-168), and optional region/seismic zone, newest first (max 20), plus explicit felt-earthquake API availability metadata.

tools.name: get_volcano_status
tools.description: Returns current aviation color codes (VONA) and volcanic alert levels (VALS) for Icelandic volcanic systems from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/volcanoes), sorted with elevated unrest first (max 20).

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Returns latest live weather station observations from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/weather 10-min AWS & SYNOP) and optional short-term XML forecast (xmlweather.vedur.is) for a town or station in Iceland.

tools.name: get_weather_warnings
tools.description: Returns active Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) weather and natural-hazard warnings from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/cap), returning an explicit empty state when none are active (max 20).

tools.name: get_road_conditions
tools.description: Returns live Icelandic road surface conditions, closures, weight restrictions, and regional advisories from IRCA / Vegagerðin (umferdin.is/graphql with gagnaveita.vegagerdin.is REST fallback), ranked with hazards first (max 20).

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Returns upcoming cultural events, concerts, nightlife (open mic, comedy/stand-up, trivia/pub quiz, bars), and active museum exhibitions in Reykjavík from curated KV feeds (next 30 days) with https booking_url (max 20).

tools.name: get_cinema_showtimes
tools.description: Returns current movie listings and upcoming cinema showtimes in Reykjavík (Bíó Paradís, Smárabíó, Sambíóin, Laugarásbíó) with https booking_url per screening from curated KV feeds (max 20 movies).

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Returns latest Icelandic news headlines from official public RSS feeds (RÚV English/Icelandic, Iceland Monitor / mbl.is, The Reykjavík Grapevine) — strictly headline, date, source, and URL without copying article body text (max 20).

tools.name: get_aurora_forecast
tools.description: Returns Veðurstofa Íslands (IMO) aurora activity index (0-9), sunset/darkness/sunrise windows, moon phase metadata, and hourly cloud-cover percentage for a place in Iceland.

tools.name: get_kef_flights
tools.description: Returns Keflavík International Airport (KEF) live arrivals and departures, flight statuses, gates, baggage belts, and schedule delays from Isavia / kefairport.com (max 20).

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Returns latest hourly air quality and volcanic gas (SO2, H2S, PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, CO) measurements from Iceland's Environment and Energy Agency (api.ust.is / loftgaedi.is), optionally ranked by distance to a place (max 20).

tools.name: get_isk_rates
tools.description: Returns official Icelandic króna (ISK) reference mid-rates from the Central Bank of Iceland (Seðlabanki Íslands / cb.is) for EUR, USD, GBP, DKK, NOK, SEK, CHF, CAD, JPY, SDR, and optional extended currencies.

tools.name: get_pools
tools.description: Returns City of Reykjavík municipal swimming pool opening hours (regular weekly and holiday schedules) from reykjavik.is, current open-now status in Atlantic/Reykjavik time, and link to live visitor counts.

tools.name: get_bus_departures
tools.description: Searches Strætó bus stops across Iceland and returns upcoming live/scheduled arrivals from opendata.straeto.is (Based on data from Strætó bs.) (max 20).

tools.name: get_avalanche_warnings
tools.description: Returns regional avalanche danger levels and snowpack notes from Veðurstofa Íslands (IMO, gottvedur.is) for monitored Icelandic mountain regions.

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: Returns statutory Icelandic public holidays, half-day holidays (Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve from 13:00), and official flag days (fánadagar) calculated deterministically per Stjórnarráð Íslands & Alþingi acts.

tools.name: get_daylight
tools.description: Calculates sunrise, sunset, solar noon, daylight duration, and civil/nautical/astronomical twilight in Atlantic/Reykjavik (UTC+0) for Icelandic towns (Reykjavík, Akureyri, Ísafjörður, Egilsstaðir, Vík, Höfn, etc.).

tools.name: get_tides
tools.description: Returns high and low tide predictions (time and height in meters) for Reykjavík and 49 other Icelandic harbours from tide.is (based on Icelandic Coast Guard Sjávarfallatöflur & TICON-4).

tools.name: get_ferries
tools.description: Returns schedules, live rerouting/cancellation notices, and booking links for Icelandic ferries: Herjólfur (Vestmannaeyjar), Baldur (Breiðafjörður), Sæfari (Grímsey), Sævar (Hrísey), and Viðey Ferry.

tools.name: get_highland_roads
tools.description: Returns Vegagerðin status for Icelandic highland F-roads (F26, F35, F88, F208, F225, etc.), regional highland notifications, and explicit out-of-season notice when roads have no winter service (max 20).

tools.name: get_eruption_hazards
tools.description: Returns official Veðurstofa Íslands (IMO) Reykjanes hazard-map status, VONA/VALS alert levels, active CAP warnings, Vegagerðin Grindavík/Reykjanes road closures (Routes 43, 425, 426, 427), and Civil Protection advisories.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Returns petrol (95) and diesel prices per station (N1, Olís, ÓB, Orkan, Atlantsolía, Costco) from the community-maintained Gasvaktin dataset (MIT License), plus the cheapest station nearby and nationwide.

tools.name: get_ev_chargers
tools.description: Returns EV charging stations near an Icelandic town or lat/lon from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) with sockets, kW output, and operators. Live occupancy is marked unavailable where operators lack open APIs.

tools.name: get_pharmacies
tools.description: Returns nearby pharmacies from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) with open-now status, extended-hour indicators, and public urgent care hours/phones (Læknavaktin, Landspítali ER, 1700, 112).

tools.name: get_shop_hours
tools.description: Returns supermarket locations (Bónus, Krónan, Hagkaup, Nettó, Krambúðin, Costco) and regular hours from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0), combined with Icelandic statutory holiday checks via get_public_holidays rules.

tools.name: get_ski_areas
tools.description: Returns live open/closed status, lifts, weather stations, and snowmaking/slope announcements from skidasvaedi.is, hlidarfjall.is, and skitindastoll.is.

tools.name: get_parking
tools.description: Returns official Reykjavík Parking Service zone tariffs and hours (P1–P4), municipal parking garages, public-holiday free rules, and nearby parking from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0).

tools.name: get_restaurants
tools.description: Returns restaurants from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) with cuisine, address, opening hours, live open-now status, and official website/booking_url when tagged (no scraped reviews).

tools.name: get_attractions
tools.description: Returns Icelandic museums and landmarks (National Museum, Harpa, Reykjavík Art Museum, Reykjavík City Museum, and others mapped in OpenStreetMap, ODbL 1.0) with hours, public prices, website, and an official ticket link where one exists.

tools.name: get_hot_springs
tools.description: Returns geothermal baths, lagoons, and natural hot springs (Sky Lagoon, Blue Lagoon, Earth Lagoon Mývatn, Fontana, etc.) from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) with hours, open-now status, and official website.

tools.name: get_hiking_trails
tools.description: Returns hiking trails (Esja, Reykjadalur, Glymur, Vatnajökull, Kerlingarfjöll, etc.) from Umhverfisstofnun WFS, Landmælingar Íslands WFS (CC BY 4.0), and OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0). Duration and ascent are only given when the source has them.

tools.name: get_city_notices
tools.description: Returns active Veitur water/heating/power outages, Reykjavík street closures & major roadworks (Borgarvefsjá ArcGIS), city news, and council meeting minutes.

tools.name: get_water_temperature
tools.description: Returns live Nauthólsvík sea and air temperature (nautholsvik.is) plus published water temperatures for Reykjavík's municipal swimming pools and hot tubs.

tools.name: get_safety_info
tools.description: Returns official 112 / 1700 / 1777 emergency contacts (112.is), live Almannavarnir civil protection advisories, active IMO CAP alerts, and official SafeTravel links.

tools.name: get_waste_collection
tools.description: Returns next Reykjavík household waste pickup dates by street address or neighborhood (Sorphirðudagatal / iCal) and live SORPA recycling center hours.

tools.name: get_libraries
tools.description: Returns Reykjavík City Library (Borgarbókasafn) branch opening hours and upcoming events plus nearby municipal libraries from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_recent_earthquakes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns recent seismic events from the Icelandic Meteorological Office (Veðurstofa Íslands, api.vedur.is/quakes), filtered by minimum magnitude, lookback hours (1-168), and optional region/seismic zone, newest first (max 20)." → after: "Returns recent seismic events from the Icelandic Meteorological Office (Veðurstofa Íslands, api.vedur.is/quakes), filtered by minimum magnitude, lookback hours (1-168), and optional region/seismic zone, newest first (max 20), plus explicit felt-earthquake API availability metadata."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
